answer.summary: Chandra warns against using a design sprint to decide which features to build or produce feature-ready designs; its purpose is to create illustrative concepts that make the strategic pillars tangible.

sections.content: Don’t treat the design sprint as a feature-selection exercise or expect it to produce feature-ready designs.
